newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qianchao to acquire auto parts makers.
newsitem.headline: Qianchao to acquire auto parts makers.

text.p: Zhejiang-based automobile parts producer Hangzhou Wanxiang Qianchao Co Ltd said on Thursday it plans to acquire four sister companies to expand operations.
The acquisition plan will be presented at a shareholders' meeting scheduled for November 25, Qianchao said in a notice published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

The four target firms are universal joint maker Zhejiang Wanxiang Machinery Co Ltd, Hangzhou Wanxiang Transmission Shaft Co Ltd, Zhejiang Special Bearings Co Ltd and Zhejiang Automobile Bearings Co, Qianchao said.
Qianchao and the four targets all have the same parent firm, Wanxiang Group, according to Qianchao's notice.
Wanxiang Group currently holds 79.60 million promoter shares in Shenzhen-listed Qianchao, accounting for 66.39 percent of Qianchao's total share capital.
Qianchao said it aims to make itself China's largest automobile parts producer over the next five years through strategic acquisitions.

Wanxiang Group holds a 75 percent stake in Zhejiang Wanxiang Machinery and 72 percent in Hangzhou Wanxiang Transmission Shaft, while both Zhejiang Special and Zhejiang Automobile are wholly-owned subsidiaries of the Wanxiang Group, Qianchao said.
Qianchao said the four target firms had combined net assets of 182.91 million yuan at the end of September and have great development potential.

In an interim report, Qianchao said that under Chinese accounting standards, it had net earnings of 27.89 million yuan in the first half of this year, compared with 17.02 million yuan notched up in the same period of 1995.
